tool.name: Icon Store
tool.description: Browse icons and pictograms and save them in many formats and sizes - e.g. for Visio diagrams.
tool.long_description: Searchable grid of all icons available in OmniWrench (Lucide, ISC licence - free for commercial use). Filter by category, see tags and the name to use in tool.json, adjust colour, stroke width and background, and save as SVG, PNG, ICO, PDF or JPG in several sizes at once - or copy the image straight into Visio, Word or PowerPoint.

fmt.svg_hint: Scalable without quality loss. Visio 2016+/365: Insert › Pictures. Size options are not needed.
fmt.png_hint: One file per selected size (name_32.png …). Transparent background.
fmt.ico_hint: One .ico file containing all selected sizes (max. 256 px).
fmt.pdf_hint: Vector PDF with the largest selected size as page size - good for printing and older Visio versions.
fmt.jpg_hint: One file per selected size, white background.
